summary: The RptMnuPlcSch_NISConflictReport is a web user control in the HSPnet system designed to facilitate the generation of NIS conflict reports within a specified date range and term selection. It uses various ASP.NET web controls and leverages the HSPnet session for user-specific data retrieval and report creation.
purpose: To generate NIS (Network Integration System) conflict reports for selected terms and date ranges, used primarily for conflict resolution related to student placements and agency interactions.

fields.name: ddTerm
fields.description: Dropdown list for selecting the term.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: Textbox for entering the start date.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: Textbox for entering the end date.

fields.name: ddPlacingAgency
fields.description: Dropdown list for selecting the placing agency.

fields.name: cmdRunReport
fields.description: Button to initiate the report generation.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Initiates the report generation process by selecting terms, dates, and agencies.

actors.name: System
actors.role: Processes the report generation and interacts with the database to retrieve necessary data.

workflows.name: Generate NIS Conflict Report
steps: User selects a term from the ddTerm dropdown.
User enters a start date in the txtStartDate textbox.
User enters an end date in the txtEndDate textbox.
User selects a placing agency from the ddPlacingAgency dropdown.
User clicks the cmdRunReport button to start report generation.
System validates input and confirms UserSession is active.
System calls PrintJobs.ReportNISCreateJob with parameters to create the report.

business_rules: The report can only be generated if the user session is active.
The placing agency and term must be selected for the report to be generated.
validations: RegularExpressionValidator1 and RegularExpressionValidator2 ensure date inputs are in the correct format.
CustomValidator1 may be used for additional validations not specified in retrieved content.
system_behavior: Displays report options and descriptions based on user session and retrieved code records.
Registers and executes JavaScript for input field interactions and resets.
Handles asynchronous postbacks for dynamic page updates.
dependencies: Requires HSPnet session data for report parameters.
Interacts with database objects via ASP.NET ObjectDataSource controls.
exceptions: Report generation is cancelled if the UserSession is not active.
